tier_note: All beats core_canon. world_time uses M1/M2/M3 for the three months the season spans; the season opens on M1-D04.

beats.what_happened: chaitra presents six original documents for teacher-recruitment verification and is told the file is flagged on a deceased-record cross-check.

state_changes.fact: her recruitment file is flagged, not cleared

beats.what_happened: basavaraj stamps her study certificate REJECTED in violet ink.

state_changes.fact: defaced with a rejection stamp; a fresh certified copy will cost forty rupees and eleven days

beats.what_happened: At chaitra's own demand basavaraj reads aloud to ninety waiting people that the man named as her father died on 14 August 1994.

state_changes.fact: publicly humiliated in front of ninety witnesses; public standing at its lowest point of the season
ninety people now carry the story out of the building

beats.what_happened: savithri burns the certified copy of the birth certificate in the kitchen fire rather than answer chaitra's three questions.

state_changes.fact: has openly destroyed evidence in front of her daughter
now certain her mother knows something

beats.what_happened: harsha's family return the engagement tray at the gate without entering the house, in view of the lane.

state_changes.fact: the match is publicly withdrawn
has let his mother return the tray at a gate and will carry that

beats.location: the family house, inner room, trunk under the cot
beats.what_happened: chaitra finds the 1994 appointment order in the trunk and sees that the photograph gummed to its corner is not her father's face.

state_changes.fact: holds physical proof that the appointee and her father are two different men

beats.what_happened: mallesha refuses to look at the photograph and leaves for school before six.

state_changes.fact: has now refused his daughter to her face

beats.what_happened: thammanna collects twelve hundred rupees from the rice tin as he has on the seventh of every month since 1998, and in the same visit raises the unmutated four acres at Nerlige.

state_changes.fact: has now made his monthly collection in front of the daughter for the first time
named aloud as leverage

beats.what_happened: thammanna leaves the receipt book open on the step; chaitra counts 288 entries of twelve hundred rupees each, every one signed by her father in an unfamiliar hand, the earliest predating her birth.

state_changes.fact: knows the arrangement is twenty-four years old and monthly
physically in the family's possession from this moment

beats.what_happened: Asked point-blank for mallesha's name after nineteen years in the next room, girija can only answer 'Master'.

state_changes.fact: has discovered she does not know the name of the man she has taught beside for nineteen years

beats.what_happened: A departmental staff census requires every teacher to answer to their name and give a thumb impression in front of the whole school; chaitra interrupts from the back and demands the name be read at full volume.

state_changes.fact: has forced the question into public in front of four hundred children and the block education officer
now personally present at the moment the discrepancy is aired

beats.what_happened: shankarappa reads out the name Lokanath and mallesha raises his hand and answers present, in front of four hundred children and his daughter.

state_changes.fact: has seen her father answer to the dead name and can no longer treat the discrepancy as clerical
the impersonation is now witnessed by his own daughter

beats.what_happened: ratnamma comes to the house and states that she was married eleven days to the appointee, who died on 14 August 1994 after a lorry collision at the Hosakere junction on his way to file the joining report.

state_changes.fact: learns the dead man was real, recent, and married
the twenty-eight-year concealment of ratnamma from her children collapses

beats.location: the lane outside the family house
beats.what_happened: ratnamma challenges mallesha in the lane to say what she is to him; he answers with a line about the fourth standard timetable and walks to the cowshed.

state_changes.fact: publicly refused acknowledgement for the twenty-eighth year

beats.what_happened: ratnamma produces the only print of the 16 July 1994 wedding photograph, in which mallesha stands behind the groom holding the garland; chaitra learns the two men were brothers.

state_changes.fact: knows the appointee was her father's elder brother
now the only surviving image of the two brothers together, and in the family's sightline

beats.what_happened: mallesha states in eleven sentences that the house was mortgaged for thirty-eight thousand rupees for the marriage, that the appointee died before joining so nothing was payable, and that a block office clerk came in September 1994 and told him the date column of a joining report is written by a clerk.

state_changes.fact: now knows the whole mechanism and who built it
has confessed aloud for the first time in twenty-eight years

beats.what_happened: chaitra names the shame she has carried since she was eight — that she told people her father was a coward for never standing for a photograph — and mallesha explains the avoidance in one sentence about newspapers reaching the block office.

state_changes.fact: the childhood shame is transferred from her father to the arrangement

beats.what_happened: chaitra opens the cloth pouch and finds that column four of her own birth certificate, registered 14 January 2000, names lokanath as her father.

state_changes.fact: every state record of her existence descends from a dead man's name

beats.what_happened: inchara introduces herself and reveals she has held a photocopy of the Nerlige family tree register since 2019 and has done nothing with it while waiting for someone from that house to become angry in a government building.

state_changes.fact: in play; three years of held material now has a subject

beats.what_happened: chaitra files form fifteen for correction of the father's name in the birth register and says the name mallesha aloud in a government office for the first time since 1994.

state_changes.fact: the correction application exists on the record
learns the family will not stay quiet

beats.what_happened: thammanna states his price — the four acres mutated to his son-in-law and a resignation signed in the dead name by the fifth of next month — and enters the correction application in the inward register as received from 'daughter of Lokanath'.

state_changes.fact: under a dated ultimatum with a named deadline
carries the dead name in thammanna's own hand this month

beats.what_happened: chaitra intercepts revanna between the chair and the car; he orders her file reopened and directs that the reason be read out at the counter, and states that an anonymous 2019 complaint from that taluk was returned to him marked no irregularity over puttaraju's signature.

state_changes.fact: has an order from the deputy director
now personally invested and personally embarrassed
his 2019 nil report is on the deputy director's mind

beats.what_happened: basavaraj reads the reopening order aloud to the same corridor of ninety people and addresses chaitra as madam.

state_changes.fact: first public acknowledgement, from the man who humiliated her, in front of the same witnesses
has committed himself publicly

beats.what_happened: The movement register shows mallesha's district service file was requisitioned at 09:20 that morning by thammanna, purpose recorded as pre-audit scrutiny.

state_changes.fact: holds the district copy of the service file
learns the antagonist moves before she does

beats.what_happened: mallesha writes a voluntary retirement letter on false medical grounds and signs it in the dead name, intending to meet thammanna's terms and clear his daughter's file.

state_changes.fact: has produced forgery number two hundred and eighty-nine

beats.what_happened: shankarappa refuses to forward the resignation and states that he compared the joining photograph with the man in 2011, saw they were different men, locked the register and said nothing for eleven years.

state_changes.fact: eleven years of concealment admitted aloud
learns the school copy of the register was never in thammanna's reach

beats.what_happened: Before school that morning shankarappa posted, by registered acknowledgement due from a post office outside his own village, a statement to revanna naming which man has signed the Nerlige staff attendance register since 1998 and admitting his own eleven-year silence.

state_changes.fact: set in motion by a document nobody in the story watched being posted

beats.note: deliberate open canon: unwitnessed at the moment it occurred; the postal receipt is produced later in the same episode

beats.what_happened: thammanna rides past the gate without stopping on the seventh for the first time in twenty-four years; the audit team sat on the fifth and he handed nothing over.

state_changes.fact: the monthly payment ends; thammanna is no longer selling silence but controlling timing

beats.location: Nerlige school, gate and assembly ground
beats.what_happened: ratnamma demands in the school yard that mallesha say his own name once and she will tear up the petition; he answers with the fourth standard timetable and walks to his classroom.

state_changes.fact: refuses his own name a second time, now in front of the whole school
has spent her last private appeal

beats.what_happened: A claim petition for forty-one lakh sixty thousand rupees is served at the school gate at assembly time, naming the department as first respondent and savithri as second; ratnamma privately tells chaitra she wants a paper and not the money, and gives her until the hearing on the twenty-second.

state_changes.fact: named in a court paper for the first time in her life
twelve days to settle a claim she agrees is just

beats.what_happened: seetharama produces volume four of his seva register; the entry of 16 July 1994 records the marriage, and records that the dakshine was paid by the groom's younger brother.

state_changes.fact: documented for the first time anywhere

beats.what_happened: Under rule sixty-one revanna accepts the temple record plus two attesting statements — from the bride's uncle and from girija, who attended the 1994 marriage — and sanctions family pension to ratnamma, arrears referred to government.

state_changes.fact: recognised on a government order as the appointee's widow
has put her name to a statement against the arrangement

beats.what_happened: ratnamma withdraws the claim as against savithri, says so aloud in front of the lane, and is taken inside the house for the first time in twenty-eight years.

state_changes.fact: out of the litigation
admitted into the house

beats.what_happened: Four lines below the marriage entry, the seva register records the funeral rites of 25 August 1994 — eighty fed, sixteen hundred and one rupees — with the payer's column filled in the name of thammanna, three weeks before he claims he was first deputed to the village.

state_changes.fact: placed at the death, paying, before the impersonation began
does not yet know who paid for his brother's rites

beats.what_happened: puttaraju states he signed the 2019 nil report without reading it, one of sixty-one files signed that day; shankarappa admits article two orally in front of his own staff.

state_changes.fact: his defence is on record and it is that he does not read
admitted on the record

beats.what_happened: mallesha refuses his name three times; chaitra says it aloud from the back of the hall and girija repeats it in front of the staff; nagaraj records the name mallesha and takes the spelling.

state_changes.fact: named on a government record under his own name for the first time since 1994
publicly the author of the fact her family concealed for twenty-four years
second scalp: acknowledges out loud what she could not say in episode 4

beats.what_happened: nagaraj announces there will be a criminal reference and recovery of all pay drawn since November 1994, then asks mallesha to sign the statement in his own name; mallesha states he has not written his own name since 4 November 1994 and takes four minutes over four letters.

state_changes.fact: signs his own name; uses the first person for the first time in the season
a recovery of unstated size now pending against the heirs

beats.what_happened: Sale deed number 1147 conveying the four acres by the canal is registered on the strength of the 2011 general power of attorney; no member of the family is present and none learns of it for fifteen days.

state_changes.fact: sold out from under the family without a single witness from it

beats.note: deliberate open canon: the season's most consequential beat happens with nobody present and nobody watching

beats.what_happened: savithri states that in 2011, when prakash's chest fever needed eleven thousand rupees the house did not have, thammanna had her execute a general power of attorney she never read to the end.

state_changes.fact: the source of the sale is her own signature and she says so
learns the debt was incurred for him

beats.what_happened: thammanna's recorded statement casts him as the 2019 informant and a reluctant recipient of a bribe paid by the family for twenty-four years; he produces the receipt book counterfoils and denies the temple entry as a priest's book.

state_changes.fact: has converted twenty-four years of extortion into twenty-four years of evidence against the family
recast on the record as the briber

beats.what_happened: inchara hands over the recovery notice for one crore eleven lakh forty thousand rupees and the office file copy of the 2019 complaint, whose covering slip is signed by thammanna.

state_changes.fact: holds proof that thammanna wrote the complaint, buried it, and chose the month it would surface
a recovery notice with a number on it, served at the house

beats.what_happened: In the same corridor and in front of the same ninety witnesses, chaitra produces three documents: the seva register entry placing thammanna as payer of the 1994 funeral, the 2011 registered power of attorney in which thammanna personally identified savithri as the wife of a man dead seventeen years, and the receipt book counterfoils whose body text is in the same hand as this month's inward register entry.

state_changes.fact: the mechanism he built in 1994 is broken in public by a document he signed himself
the reversal is cashed in front of the witnesses to her humiliation

beats.what_happened: thammanna is arrested in the corridor on the registered-document offence, and his name is spelled aloud twice — once into the enquiry record and once on the arrest memo.

state_changes.fact: arrested in front of ninety witnesses after thirty-one years without a transfer

beats.what_happened: revanna settles the ledger aloud: sale deed and mutation referred for cancellation and the four acres restored; ratnamma's arrears recommended against thammanna and not the family; shankarappa censured permanently and the school's second building block sanctioned; puttaraju suspended; mallesha dismissed, criminally referred, and the recovery reduced by the three lakh forty-five thousand six hundred rupees proved extorted; savithri says her husband's name aloud to strangers for the first time.

state_changes.fact: restored to the pre-2011 entry
arrears routed to her, out of thammanna's recoverable sum
dismissed and prosecuted under his own name; not saved, but named
speaks her husband's name in public

beats.what_happened: harsha's family return the engagement tray and chaitra refuses the match aloud in front of the corridor, in the same public form in which it was withdrawn.

state_changes.fact: the episode-2 humiliation is answered in the same currency, and on her own terms
refused in public

beats.what_happened: basavaraj reads serial nine of the district appointment list aloud to the corridor: assistant teacher, Nerlige — chaitra, daughter of mallesha.

state_changes.fact: appointed; public standing at its season high
his own name enters a district register for the first time in twenty-four years
closes the loop he opened in episode 1, at the same volume
